title: Iran war helps fuel global drop in fossil fuel emissions — but there’s a catch
caption:
For the first time since 2020, global fossil fuel emissions have seen a slight decrease. While renewable energy is helping, researchers found that high oil prices caused by the Iran conflict played a massive role in the dip.

Source: Livescience - Iran war helps fuel global drop in fossil fuel emissions — but there’s a catch

https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/climate-change/worlds-fossil-fuel-emissions-will-fall-this-year-scientists-say-partly-because-of-the-iran-war
